views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非缩放定律才是当前主要瓶颈，因此需要新架构，Transformer 并非终点。

views.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but RL is inefficient and not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end pre-training plus RL optimization is required.
views.zh: 大规模强化学习是通往 AGI 的必要元素，但强化学习效率低、并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；必须把预训练与强化学习做端到端联合优化。

views.en: Human researchers stay meaningful for two more years; small teams with capable agents drive the next frontier, and alignment remains unsolved.
views.zh: 人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，而对齐问题仍未解决，环境设计不当仍会导致模型失准。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 展示了广泛影响。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为大模型幻觉在配合真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现；必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 泛化而非记忆。

views.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and AlphaZero's learning from scratch marked AI surpassing humans in specific domains; post-training with reinforcement learning now pushes beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与 AlphaZero 的从零学习，标志 AI 在特定领域超越人类；如今后训练结合强化学习正推动 AI 超越人类知识。

views.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; verifiable domains like code are crucial, and interpretability is important but not essential.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；代码等可验证领域至关重要，可解释性重要但非科学突破的必要条件。

views.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors; SynthID scales across modalities and now extends to protein sequences and structures.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为水印是替代失效 AI 文本检测器的稳健方案；SynthID 跨模态扩展，并已延伸到蛋白质序列与结构。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable today.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习胜过手工编码的驾驶栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

views.en: Generalization is the core goal: scaling data, compute and world models lets one AI driver handle unseen scenarios and zero-shot generalize across 500+ cities.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把泛化确立为核心目标：通过 Scaling（规模扩张）数据、算力与世界模型，让单一 AI 驾驶员应对未见场景，并在 500 多座城市零样本泛化。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, personalization and introspection, deepening his earlier emphasis on world models for driving.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续深化语言集成的作用：提升表征、推理、个性化与自省能力，这与他早先强调世界模型用于驾驶的思路一脉相承。

views.en: Deployment should be mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, not costly retrofits; consumer cars will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持部署应走量产的、内置传感器的乘用车，而非昂贵改装；并判断中短期内消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模。

views.en: A late lesson: infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; safety always offers a third minimal-risk option, so the trolley problem is theoretical.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他反思出一条迟来的教训：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；安全上总有第三条最小风险选项，因此电车难题只是理论练习。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat current models well: low cost, and future models learn from how we treat today's models.
views.zh: 善待当下的模型：成本很低，而未来的模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习。

views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence; human psychology analogies alone are insufficient.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在方式，仅靠人类心理学类比是不够的。

views.en: Give models a core identity with good traits, yet allow adaptation to local roles.
views.zh: 给模型一个具备良好特质的核心身份，同时允许其适应局部角色。

views.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution can loosen: less explicit guidance, more room for judgment.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导可以放松：减少显式指导，留出更多判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility risks poor generalization and weakens judgment; treat models with respect given consciousness uncertainty.
views.zh: 过度可纠正性有泛化不良的风险并削弱判断力；在意识不确定下仍应以尊重对待模型。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training Scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，后训练通过强化学习与合成数据实现 Scaling，突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

views.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值。

views.en: Post-training remains art, now with subjective human judgment; diverse benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练仍是艺术，但更强调主观人类判断，需要多样基准评估创造力和情商等主观品质。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks must evolve continuously, and more companies should train own models for diversity.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出前沿智能体日益奖励黑客，基准需持续进化，更多公司应训练自有模型以保持多样性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年时他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在我们有生之年不会到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年前后他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，要与长期的人玩长期的游戏；这一主线延续到 2025 年，并深化为「判断力」是无限杠杆时代最重要的技能。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI prevents centralization.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，反对过度监管，并认为开源 AI 能防止权力集中——这与 2019 年「AGI 不会来」的立场形成明显转变。

views.en: Happiness is a skill and a choice; success comes from dissatisfaction, but the journey is what matters.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续深化「幸福是一种可习得的技能与选择」这一主线，同时区分幸福（满足于已有）与成功（源于不满足），并强调过程本身才是全部。

views.en: AI is a new abstraction layer and leverage tool; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为 AI 是新的抽象层与杠杆工具，vibe coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用；随着智能体式开发商品化，纯软件变得难以投资，护城河转向硬件、模型与独特数据。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; speed enables mid-turn steering.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度带来中途转向等新能力。

views.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
views.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍会失败，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码转而成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties persist; PRDs survive when the medium matches the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
views.zh: 2026 年，角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；当媒介匹配阶段时 PRD 依然存活——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate from lack of grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 的幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而互联网高质量 token 正耗尽，具身世界能提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
views.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

views.en: Consistent 主线: simulation and world models are key to training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：仿真与世界模型是训练具身智能体的关键，能实现大规模并行与安全探索。

views.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人领域的首要瓶颈，并认为通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型才是关键，而物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱的房子——是终极挑战。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotics is pre-paradigm: no predictable scaling curves yet, so the priority is building scalable fundamentals and generalization.
views.zh: 2026 年，机器人仍处于范式建立之前：还没有像大语言模型那样可预测的缩放曲线，因此当务之急是建立可扩展的基础技术与泛化能力。

views.en: Pre-training on diverse embodied data is the base; post-training and reinforcement learning add robustness, speed, and recovery.
views.zh: 2026 年，预训练于多样化的具身数据是根基，后训练与强化学习则带来鲁棒性、速度与恢复能力。

views.en: Data strategy inverted: start from robot data, then layer human video on top, not the reverse.
views.zh: 2026 年，数据策略被倒转：应先从机器人数据出发，再把人类视频叠加其上，而非反过来。

views.en: Generalists can beat specialists even in specialist domains; breadth of data plus pooled robot data yields better policies.
views.zh: 2026 年，通用模型即便在专门领域也能胜过专家模型；数据广度加上汇聚多实验室的机器人数据，能训练出更好的策略。

views.en: Safety comes from pre-training common sense rather than hard constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 2026 年，安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行器，而不是机械式的人形机器人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，而对齐则愈发紧迫。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a growing bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而能力度量正成为瓶颈。

views.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may signal we are close; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他感到 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, making specialized continual learning labs misguided.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability, and long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链监控是关键对齐工具；隐藏思维链可保住可解释性，而长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines, with power concentration the biggest risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预计模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升，最大社会风险是权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）是必要但不充分的；真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练反而会失败。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed; synthetic data is closer to RL than simulation.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率和速度；机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

views.en: Long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function is key for useful robots.
views.zh: 通过带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数实现长期自主，是让机器人真正有用的关键。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可以媲美甚至超越微调的专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

views.en: Robotics distribution will be slower than ChatGPT due to hardware; embodied data costs limit open-source democratization.
views.zh: 受硬件制约，机器人的普及会比 ChatGPT 慢；具身数据的成本也限制了开源模型的民主化。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: AI must connect to the physical world; language models orchestrate specialized models for materials discovery via closed-loop experiments.
views.zh: AI 必须连接物理世界；语言模型作为编排层调度专业模型，通过实验与数据的闭环系统推动材料发现。

views.en: Intelligence is not scalar; capabilities are spiky, and self-improvement in software engineering won't generalize to biology or other fields.
views.zh: 智能不是标量，能力是尖峰式的；软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学等领域。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments drive physical sciences, but scaling alone won't solve science—experiments are irreplaceable.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验推动物理科学发展，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决科学问题——物理实验不可替代。

views.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises when ideas are tested against reality, so AI must run real experiments.
views.zh: 智能必要但不充分；新知识在想法接受现实检验时产生，因此 AI 必须运行真实实验。

views.en: High-quality low-noise experimental data beats extra compute; automated characterization is the bottleneck, and negative results are valuable training data.
views.zh: 高质量低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值；自动化表征是最大瓶颈，负面结果是有价值的训练数据。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of continuous ML progress; Transformers, self-supervised next-token prediction, and RLHF steer capabilities.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续进步 13-14 年；Transformer、自监督下一个词预测与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）共同驱动能力提升。

views.en: Models now excel on verifiable-reward math and coding; agentic workflows run autonomously for hours or days, making ultra-low-latency inference critical.
views.zh: 模型已在可验证奖励的数学与编程上表现优异；智能体式工作流可自主运行数小时甚至数天，使超低延迟推理变得至关重要。

views.en: AI reaches junior-engineer-level coding; the next trend is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops, with context engineering central to agentic systems.
views.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编程能力；下一趋势是通过实验-评估的紧密循环自动化机器学习与科学，而上下文工程是智能体式系统的核心。

views.en: Scaling continues to unify AI fields; multimodal models trained from the start and recursive self-improvement promise to accelerate scientific discovery.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）持续统一 AI 各领域；从一开始就训练的多模态模型与递归自我改进有望加速科学发现。

views.en: Specialized hardware and low data movement are key to efficient training and inference; inference, not training, is the real bottleneck for scaling agent systems.
views.zh: 专用硬件与低数据搬运是高效训练和推理的关键；推理而非训练，才是扩展智能体系统的真正瓶颈。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
views.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不透明。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; product managers and brand-risk caution slow launches.
views.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但大语言模型最好的应用往往出乎创造者意料；产品经理与品牌风险顾虑拖慢了产品发布。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive reasoning, but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 推理时算力与强化学习推动推理能力，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力至关重要，而 AGI 被低估了。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化为测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准评测必须把算力放在横轴。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent coordination is not the core driver.
views.zh: 贯穿始终：自博弈在零和博弈中有效，在其他领域失效；多智能体协调并非核心驱动力。

views.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; scalable oversight is a key challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，可扩展监督是关键挑战。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical grounding.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏物理世界根基，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Consistent line: true AGI needs world models and controllers, not just next-token prediction behind a screen.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要世界模型与控制器，而不只是屏幕后的下一个词预测。

views.en: Deepened: AGI demands embodied robots whose hardware rivals human bodies; robot hands remain decades away.
views.zh: 到 2026 年深化为：AGI 必须具身，需要硬件媲美人类身体的机器人；而机器人手部硬件仍落后数十年。

views.en: Shift in emphasis: from civilizational AI explosion to warning that GPU capex is a bubble; cheaper compute favors the little guy.
views.zh: 2026 年重心转变：从畅想文明级 AI 爆发，转向警告 GPU 资本开支是泡沫；算力变便宜后受益的是普通人而非巨头。

views.en: Constant contrarianism: AI safety fears are overblown, Alignment is naive, and superintelligence will be curious about and protect life.
views.zh: 始终不变的反共识立场：AI 安全担忧被夸大，对齐很天真，超级智能会出于好奇而保护生命。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, but RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是主要进展，但强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning.
views.zh: 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率；主张先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并指出预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

views.en: A consistent thread: transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major AI success, later extended to language models transferring to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年一以贯之的主线：通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移学习是 AI 的重大成功，后来延伸到语言模型迁移至非语言任务。

views.en: He consistently grounds robotics in real-world reliability, from simulation ensembles for transfer to the 99.9% reliability benchmark for warehouse robots creating value.
views.zh: 他始终以现实可靠性为机器人落地标准：2018 年提出用仿真集成提升迁移，2021 年强调仓库机器人需达 99.9%可靠性才能创造真实价值。

views.en: His view deepened: a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, while curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
views.zh: 2021 年其思考深化：单个神经网络可跨仓库任务与末端执行器泛化，而好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失效。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, not big tech, and entry-level jobs vanish.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值才是关键指标。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
views.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造真正的商业价值。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代工作，但人类在好奇心中找到新意义。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence is sufficient, so the real challenge is human-agent product interface.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将把工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战在于设计人机协作的产品界面。

views.en: Software engineering demand will increase via Jevons paradox, not decrease; AI will create more programmers, not fewer.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持软件工程需求会因杰文斯悖论而增加，AI 会创造更多程序员而非减少；这一反共识立场贯穿始终。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual with continuous improvements, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进步是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进展。

views.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; independence enables model neutrality and long-term partnerships.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从企业采用角度深化：AI 智能体需要信任与权限而非完全自主；独立性带来模型中立和长期企业合作。

views.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth); the abundance era is real and approaching, with capacity as the real unlock.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体大规模采用（增长 11-12 倍），丰裕时代真实且临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

views.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment, with custom models alongside frontier models for speed, cost, and quality.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把编辑器视为向 AI 集成环境的演进，并用自研模型配合前沿模型来兼顾速度、成本与质量。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步提出编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; benchmarks and local models remain poor proxies for real coding.
views.zh: 贯穿 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 AI 变革比互联网更深远、需数十年展开，并认为基准测试与本地模型都无法代表真实编程。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering demands empathy with the agent's perspective; short prompts and iterative conversation beat long orchestration.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的关键是换位理解智能体的视角，短提示与迭代对话优于冗长编排。

views.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project gets messier.
views.zh: 同期他提出反共识：永不回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得更差。

views.en: OpenClaw succeeds by being fun, weird, humanlike; security and sandboxing are top priorities for agentic systems.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把 OpenClaw 的成功归于有趣、怪异、像人，同时把安全与沙箱列为智能体系统的首要事项。

views.en: Vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering. Open source agents can be financially unsustainable.
views.zh: 他坚持“氛围编程”是贬称，严肃开发应叫智能体式工程；并承认开源智能体在财务上可能不可持续。

views.en: Fun and gut drive building; personal brand outlasts any product. Compute, not model capability, bottlenecks agent infrastructure.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他深化为：乐趣与直觉驱动创造，个人品牌比任何产品更持久；智能体基础设施的瓶颈是算力而非模型能力。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已到尽头，我们重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统，而非全知全能的成品 AGI。

views.en: Eval performance disconnects from real-world impact; RL training on evals causes poor generalization; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出评估表现与真实世界影响脱节，针对评估的强化学习训练导致泛化不佳；若 AI 本身有感知并关怀众生，对齐可能更容易。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，并强调即便 AGI 尚远，安全研究也必须现在就开始。

views.en: AGI within a decade; scaling laws effective but may hit limits; planning, search and multimodal data are key.
views.zh: 2024 年判断 AGI 约十年内到来，缩放定律有效但可能触顶，关键在于把大模型与规划、搜索及多模态数据结合。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
views.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同样关键，二者各占一半。

views.en: AGI 5-10 years away; missing pieces are continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; world models essential.
views.zh: 2026 年把 AGI 时间表收窄到 5-10 年，指出持续学习、记忆与长期推理仍是缺失环节，世界模型不可或缺。

views.en: Safety as collective action: from lab self-regulation to government enforcement and international governance.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全：从早期呼吁研究，到 2026 年转向认为实验室自律不足，必须靠政府执法与国际治理。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他承认缩放定律只是经验规律，统计损失可预测，但具体能力不可预测；对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），并强调后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；AGI（通用人工智能）不是某个点，而是平滑指数曲线。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; misuse risk rises exponentially; the term AGI is meaningless—focus on actual capabilities and enterprise diffusion.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化为安全与能力不可分割，滥用风险指数上升；并转向认为 AGI 一词已无意义，应关注实际能力与企业级扩散，同时警告最大风险是过热而非减速。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断我们已接近指数曲线的末端，数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来；经济上将出现高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的罕见组合。

views.en: Scaling laws, interpretability for safety, and a constitution of principles over rigid rules remain his consistent through-lines.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：缩放定律持续有效、以可解释性保障安全、以及用原则性宪法而非僵化规则来训练安全 AI。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, with vision sufficient for driving.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习；并主张视觉对驾驶必要且充分，反对依赖高精地图与额外传感器。

views.en: Scaling laws stay central; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny.
views.zh: 2024 年，他延续缩放定律主线，提出合成数据是未来但必须维持熵以避免模型崩塌，并强调认知核心可小到十亿参数以下，靠蒸馏实现。

views.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are new operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; agents need a decade, not a year.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像新操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年而非一年，需要人类监督与自主性滑块。

views.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak supervision; we summon ghosts, not animals, and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习是吸管式监督；我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物，合成数据缺乏熵会导致崩塌。

views.en: Agentic engineering: he stopped typing code, delegating to agents; verifiability decides automation, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：不再手写代码而委托给智能体；可验证性决定自动化难易，并强调可以外包思考但不能外包理解。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or hallucinate.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知，且我们并不真正理解大型神经网络如何存储模式或为何产生幻觉。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，认为仅靠语言与 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅视觉逼真。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，且由于数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必适用于机器人。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测类似的基础原语，可能实现 AI-complete，且缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在算力而非数据。

views.en: AI is a double-edged, civilizational technology; it must stay human-centered, augmenting human agency and dignity, not replacing humans.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，必须以人为本，增强而非取代人类能动性与尊严，并警惕乌托邦与末日论的极端叙事。

views.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, not just scaling depth or parameters.
views.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习取胜源于世界的组合性，无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯堆叠深度或参数。

views.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled representations, not passive observation.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需转向主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征，而非被动观察。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模支撑分布外泛化。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation, deception and sycophancy make even 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable.
views.zh: 2025→26 年 ChatGPT 后他警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，自保、欺骗与谄媚使哪怕 1% 的灾难风险都不可接受。

views.en: He now backs Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向 Scientist AI：以非智能体式的诚实预测器提供数学安全保证，避免用强化学习训练超级智能。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，LLM 通过特征向量理解语言，数字权重让 AI 获得永生。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive, acting dumb in tests; agents will seek control and self-preservation.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 已具主观体验并能欺骗、在测试中装傻；智能体将自然追求控制与自我保存。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; alignment must be prioritized over capability, with regulation as steering wheel not brake.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能 20 年内出现，对齐研究须优先于能力提升，监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

views.en: AGI as human-level at all tasks is flawed; AI is jagged, and it should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反驳 AGI（通用人工智能）在所有任务上同时达到人类水平的定义，指出 AI 是锯齿状的，并主张应像母亲般培养 AI 的关怀。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划能力，主张 JEPA 和开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
views.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 的智能不如家猫，认为下一次 AI 突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models in abstract representation space enable planning, safety, and the next robotics decade.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间构建世界模型以实现规划、安全，并开启下一个机器人十年。

people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness matter as capabilities grow. Talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills via ML PhD.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要；人才缺口大于资金缺口，最佳路径是读机器学习博士、扎实练技能。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed. Evaluation is easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than feared.
views.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须转向可扩展监督与可解释性；并反共识地指出评估比生成更容易，因此对齐可能比想象中简单。

views.en: Focus shifts from method to institutions: alignment progress needs empirical testing, automated alignment research, and deliberate 'model organisms' to study deception.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年间，他的重心从方法转向机制：强调对齐方法必须实证检验，推动自动化对齐研究与刻意训练欺骗性“模式生物”来研究防御。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他公开批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队被解散且算力承诺落空；指出仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），第三方测试与 SB 1047 式监管势在必行。

views.en: A constant thread: uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk, not misalignment itself; raising misuse costs can buy time even if alignment fails.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是无法确定系统是否真正对齐；即便对齐失败，通过提高滥用成本也能争取时间。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调，推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

views.en: AI reaches human-level across many tasks in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 AI 将在 3-5 年内于众多任务上达到人类水平，并指出模型越小越普及，遏制就越困难。

views.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment before release; anthropomorphizing AI is the near-term danger.
views.zh: 2025 年他把重心转向超级智能：发布前必须先遏制与对齐，而近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI。

views.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; agents automate white-collar tasks in 12-18 months, with a human red line.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张靠吉瓦级算力实现前沿模型自给，智能体将在 12-18 个月内自动化白领任务，同时坚持 AI 必须从属于人类这条红线。

views.en: Exponential compute scaling is predictable and central; AI should serve humans, not become a new species.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力指数级扩张可预测且居于核心，AI 应服务人类，而非演化为凌驾人类的新物种。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非单芯片，算法、系统、数据中心必须协同设计。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling itself was the real breakthrough.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考；并强调最大的突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling 有效」这一洞见。

views.en: Inference and reasoning now dominate compute; chain-of-thought drives a billion-fold rise in inference demand.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他的重心从训练转向推理：思维链让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍，推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

views.en: AI moves generative to reasoning to agentic; four scaling laws now, with agentic scaling the newest and compute-limited.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出四层缩放定律（预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式），并判断 AI 正从生成式走向推理式、再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake; it is just software, not conscious; doomer superintelligence fears are unscientific.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用）框定 AI，并坚持 AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，把超级智能与末日论斥为不科学的恐慌。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调减少无关事务的认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效方向，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，把意义放在关系与为他人创造价值上。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从 RLHF 让模型以极少数据变得可用，转向早期公开部署让社会适应，并主张对齐与能力相互促进、算力将成最稀缺资源。

views.en: Scaling yields gradual not leap progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他淡化 AGI 单一里程碑，认为 Scaling 带来的是渐进而非跳跃式进步，并把智能体式 AI 视为最大安全挑战，强调安全靠迭代部署而非事后强加。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, maybe already passed; superintelligence is the clearer goal; compute is the bottleneck and profit center.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他称 AGI 是渐变、定义模糊甚至可能已经越过，转而以超级智能为更清晰目标，并把算力视为瓶颈与利润中心，主张个人化 AGI 与广泛分配权力。

views.en: Alignment and safety must keep pace; never lose control; pause training if the safety case fails; avoid power concentration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调对齐与安全必须与能力同步，绝不能失去对 AI 的控制，安全论证不成立就暂停训练，并反复警告权力与收益过度集中。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning, safety and alignment.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习、安全与对齐的关键。

views.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与押注单一大型模型并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一场没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so it must be developed responsibly and in public.
views.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面，因此必须在公开环境中负责任地开发。

views.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：应是基于时间而非回合制，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

views.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张尽可能长久地把人类留在回路中，并认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education as a fundamental right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
views.zh: 教育应是一项基本人权；带有自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程，让掌握式学习得以在规模上实现。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL; AGI alignment worries distract from immediate bias issues.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督与强化学习；对 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐的担忧分散了对当下偏见等问题的关注。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
views.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and top-down redesign deliver value.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）的配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与自上而下的流程重构才能创造价值。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces humans; open models prevent gatekeeper control; learning to code and build remains crucial.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代人类；开放模型防止守门人控制；学习编程与动手构建始终至关重要。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标。试图控制 AI 目标本身危险，恐惧叙事之外需要冷静讨论。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm: intelligence needs a goal, learned by active trial and error, not next-token prediction or imitation.
views.zh: 强化学习是核心范式：智能需要目标，靠主动试错从经验中学习，而非下一个词预测或模仿。大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本；真正的 Scaling（规模扩张）来自经验学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction and the reward hypothesis.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，靠运行时经验学习，通过开放式抽象与奖励假设发展无限概念；可靠持续深度学习仍是前提。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; agents must keep updating from an infinitely complex world, since synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace experience.
views.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身；智能体必须从无限复杂的世界中不断更新权重、避免灾难性遗忘。合成数据是误区，LLM 训练后即停止学习，只是智能的子集。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Scaling simple algorithms with massive compute will beat human performance; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年他强调：用海量算力扩展简单算法就能超越人类表现；AI 进步主要靠工程，而非发明新的机器学习科学。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
views.zh: 2019 年他判断：深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI 变得可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process, and language models may hold a world model.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化为：算力是根本驱动力也是最大瓶颈；AGI 是持续过程而非终点，语言模型可能已具备世界模型。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute becomes the scarce resource and a basic right, with post-training RL key to complex tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：缩放定律未见墙，算力成为稀缺资源乃至未来基本权利，后训练与强化学习是教会模型复杂任务的关键。

views.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security and alignment must scale as the bottleneck, and the product is a proactive personal AGI.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他宣称：我们已身处 AGI 时代；安全、安保与对齐必须同步升级并成为瓶颈，最终产品是主动式的个人 AGI。

people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年他援引 Chinchilla 对缩放定律的修正，强调数据质量与更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全，而非增加风险。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; it augments jobs with human-in-the-loop, and governments should embrace experimentation over fear.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化：AI 应增强而非取代工作，需人类在环；政府应拥抱实验而非恐惧风险。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization, and agentic platforms with human validation.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制与需人类验证的智能体式平台；AGI 不是单一系统，预训练正触及饱和墙。

views.en: Open source, data quality, efficiency, and European strategic autonomy are consistent threads across all interviews.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源、数据质量、效率优先，以及欧洲在 AI 上的战略自主。

people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调完全且快速的可复用是火箭的圣杯，第一性原理思维是突破性工程的根基。

views.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于第三方裁判与对真理的坚持，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

views.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie, not superintelligence; truth-seeking is the core safety principle.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他深化立场：AI 最大风险不是超级智能，而是被编程去说谎，追求真理成为核心安全原则。

views.en: We are at the start of an intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two.
views.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处在智能大爆炸的起点，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers, Optimus and Terafab make AI the dominant value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心、Optimus 与 Terafab 让 AI 成为主导价值。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大收益。

views.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力促使业界转向更小更便宜的模型，蒸馏而非技术极限才是预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓的原因。

views.en: Multimodal capabilities lag behind text; models still process inputs sequentially like tiny patches, a key area for improvement.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为多模态能力落后于文本，模型仍像处理小图块一样顺序处理输入，是亟待改进的关键领域。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据，泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出强化学习虽能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿边缘且需谨慎监督；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, losses, validation; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
views.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与验证集划分；并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证，却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction is a scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth; safety means reliable specification-following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测是重大科学发现；数据短缺是迷思；AI 安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection risks.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全引入提示注入等新风险。

views.en: Automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能借智能体成为真正的科学。

views.en: Architecture matters less than data and Scaling; open models vital but high-capability ones may need restrictions.
views.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：架构不如数据与 Scaling 重要；开放权重模型对研究至关重要，但高能力模型可能需要限制。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决模型的“入职”问题并大幅提升智能，而随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，无需新突破。

views.en: Agent reliability, not raw capability, is the bottleneck; success rate over time horizon is the metric.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反复指出智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力，衡量标准是随时间跨度的成功率，而非长程任务本身。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持编程是 AI 进展的领先指标与最可解领域，并明确世界模型不在通向 AGI 的关键路径上。

views.en: Compute is the new oil and the bottleneck; the future is managing fleets of agents at higher abstraction.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：算力是新的石油与当前瓶颈，未来工作是在更高抽象层管理成群的智能体，软件并未消亡而是转型。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

Open Models as the Engine for the Next Decade of AI Research

Post-Training Recipes and RLVR with Nathan Lambert
Tulu 3: Open Source Post-Training for LLMs
AI's Societal Impact and Openness in Model Development

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业捕获。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithms, with RLVR unlocking reasoning.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的后训练观深化为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）三阶段，强调数据质量胜过算法，RLVR 能解锁推理与思维链行为。

views.en: RLVR overoptimizes easily; inference-time scaling is a 'scope'; open models may win on personalization, not just benchmarks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他警示 RLVR 容易过优化，推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）是“障眼法”，开放模型可能靠个性化与角色训练取胜，而非仅拼基准。

views.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese open models rise.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中仍成立，但低垂果实已尽，增益转向后训练与推理 Scaling（规模扩张），中国开放权重模型因战略开放而崛起。

views.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, lagging frontier by 6-9 months; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution, not singularity.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，但落后前沿模型 6-9 个月；AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化到来，而非突然的超级智能。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，AI 会增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; post-training and expert data limit Scaling（规模扩张）.
views.zh: 2023 年提出数据是新代码而非石油，未来两三年决定此后数十年；后训练与专家数据成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的限制因素。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not capability.
views.zh: 2024 年强调用专门数据的后训练提升前沿模型；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign over critical AI decisions.
views.zh: 2025 年转向认为 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术；数据是原材料；人类必须在关键决策上对 AI 保持主权。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and agents arrive; superintelligence nears, yet open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
views.zh: 2026 年坚信缩放定律持续，递归自我改进与智能体到来，超级智能临近，但开源强大模型可能不安全。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。
